By TheroPay Stellar USDC Treasury and Disbursements

Testnet Treasury and Disbursements

SCF #46
$26.0K
Build
Submitted

Products & Services

We request $26,000 to integrate DFNS and the Stellar Disbursement Platform (SDP) into a testnet version of TheroPay’s enterprise payment infrastructure. TheroPay contributes $800 toward the $26,800 total project cost.

We will build policy-controlled Stellar testnet wallets and USDC transfers through DFNS, and bulk-disbursement workflows through SDP. TheroPay’s .NET service layer will connect tenant permissions, payment approvals, transaction status, signed webhooks and ledger reconciliation. Recipients use funded test accounts and the issuer-pinned Circle testnet USDC asset. No fiat, redeemable value or real customer funds enter this environment.

Stellar supplies the payment ledger and bulk-transfer rail. Clients gain a consistent API and operations workflow for wallet creation, approval, disbursement and reconciliation. Lower settlement costs and prefunding benefits remain hypotheses for later evaluation. Stellar development has not started; implementation and evidence collection begin after funding. All funded deliverables finish on testnet.

Requested Budget

$26.0K

Traction Evidence

The August 2026 Blockwyre report attributed $40,623,000.63 of stablecoin purchases, $10,000 of crypto deposits and $36,325,422.41 of outgoing transfers to TheroPay’s agent account. These are separate transaction legs and are not summed as unique payment volume. The report records 305 traditional-payment monitoring events, not a payout count. TheroPay reports 16 active fintech, MSB and remittance-company clients.

The submission package includes the redacted August report, FinCEN registration and signed-agreement excerpts for Triple-A Technologies Inc, WhiteBIT US Inc and Zoth Intelligence SG PTE LTD. Contracts support contracted payment demand, not active-client status, volumes or Stellar usage; explicit stablecoin terms were not identified in these three agreements.

TheroPay is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Connecticut and registered with FinCEN as an MSB (31000299726160), without state money-transmitter licenses. Registration does not itself authorize all payment activities. The funded testnet is isolated from existing fiat and non-custodial Fireblocks/Blockwyre flows. Blockwyre does not currently support Stellar settlement. No client has committed to Stellar usage. A future real-value pilot requires separate legal, compliance, partner and client approvals outside this award.

Tranche 1 (Deliverable Roadmap) - MVP

Milestone 1 — wallets and treasury transfers, weeks 1–4 after award execution and initial funding. SCF allocation $7,800, funded by the $2,600 approval advance (Tranche 0) plus $5,200 Tranche 1 payment; the advance is included, not additional.

1.1 DFNS accounts, activation, issuer-pinned trustlines and signing — $4,020 SCF. Demonstrate three isolated tenant test environments, transaction hashes, approval policies, rejection of wrong issuer/network and insufficient reserves. Publish non-sensitive project code with a LICENSE file and record a wallet/transfer demonstration.

1.2 Treasury API, idempotency and ledger reconciliation — $3,780 SCF plus $240 TheroPay. Complete 25 successful post-award testnet transfers with signed webhooks, timeout recovery and duplicate-request tests. Map each transfer to one payment ID and confirmed ledger operation. All required acceptance tests pass. No mainnet deliverables.

Tranche 2 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Testnet

Milestone 2 — SDP and security controls, weeks 5–8. SCF total $7,800.

2.1 Pinned-version SDP testnet deployment, recipient registration and batch adapter — $4,020 SCF. Complete at least one batch of 100 confirmed test disbursements. Demonstrate approval separation, invalid-recipient handling and interrupted-submission recovery. Use SDP’s supported signer and registration flow; DFNS governs treasury funding, not an assumed drop-in SDP signer.

2.2 STRIDE threat model and onchain monitoring plan — $2,440 SCF plus $240 TheroPay. Inventory components and addresses; link threats to controls, triggers, owners and responses. Simulate alerts for signer changes, forged webhooks, tenant access violations, delayed payments and reconciliation mismatches. Maintain populated plans internally and provide redacted completion evidence to SCF.

2.3 Integration QA and recovery — $1,340 SCF. Test replay, sequence contention, insufficient balances, missing trustlines and provider outages. Zero duplicate confirmed payments and no unresolved Critical or High issues in the funded testnet scope.

Tranche 3 (Deliverable Roadmap) - Mainnet

Milestone 3 — testnet validation and handoff, weeks 9–12. SCF total $10,400. Entirely testnet, consistent with SCF’s October 27 invitation and November 3 metric guidance.

3.1 Final integrated testnet campaign — $5,360 SCF. Complete the proposed 500-payment, consecutive 14-day metric below, with reproducible counting script, ledger manifest and reconciliation export.

3.2 SCF sandbox, documentation and demonstration — $2,896 SCF plus $320 TheroPay. Provide time-limited SCF access, OpenAPI examples, setup instructions, pinned dependencies, non-sensitive architecture/test runner and recorded DFNS-to-SDP end-to-end flow. Resolve blocking acceptance issues.

3.3 Security closure and engineering handoff — $2,144 SCF. BitsKraft remediation, acceptance-test closure, restricted runbooks, tested monitoring and reset-recovery instructions; no unresolved Critical or High findings. Dick Dickson’s final code review is TheroPay-funded.

Total project $26,800: $25,800 engineering (three months at the change order’s $8,600 team total) plus $1,000 infrastructure. SCF $26,000; TheroPay $800. SCF allocation: DFNS $8,000, SDP $10,000, supporting layer/infrastructure $8,000. Only eligible future Stellar work is charged; no retrospective costs, duplicate hours, marketing, external audits, legal work, liquidity, token incentives or mainnet work.

Tranche 3 Onchain Metric Information

Proposed metric, subject to SCF panel ratification or adjustment: at least 500 successful testnet USDC payment operations through the integrated application during a consecutive 14-day campaign within weeks 9–12. Include at least five SDP batches of 100 completed payments each, across three isolated tenant environments and 50 distinct recipient accounts. These are synthetic tests, not external clients or economic adoption. All payments reconcile without unexplained discrepancies or duplicate execution.

Count each logical disbursement once by tenant/payment ID, supported by successful transaction hash plus operation index, ledger close time, asset code/issuer, destination and test amount. Multiple operations count only as distinct approved logical payments. Exclude treasury funding, account activation, trustlines, failed attempts, retry duplicates and circular refills. No dollar-volume threshold; test tokens have no economic value.

Register treasury, distribution, channel and recipient test addresses with SCF at award execution; update before counting new addresses. No application smart contract is planned. Provide address manifest, counting script, transaction evidence and reconciliation export. Archive records during the campaign and rerun affected tests if network resets prevent verification.
